title: Anzick child genome links Clovis to Native Americans
summary: The genome of a Clovis-era child buried about 12,900 years ago (found 1968) was closest to Native Americans, especially those of Central and South America.
why: Linked Clovis-era people to living Native Americans, especially those of Central and South America.

notes.problem: 'Today's Native Americans descend from' overclaims; source: closer relationship to Amerindians of Central and South America than to those of North America.
